hints.content: The ratio of shaded pieces to pieces per whole is $\purpleC7:4$.

Percent means per hundred.  

So, we need an equivalent ratio that will tell us how many pieces would be shaded out of $100$ pieces per whole.

|||
-|-|-|-
Shaded | $\purpleD{7}$ | $\stackrel{\times 25}\rightarrow$ | $\purpleD{175}$
Parts per whole | $4$ | $\stackrel{\times 25}\rightarrow$  | $100$
$\purpleD{175}\%$ is represented by the shaded area.
